svg.title: Stack
svg.desc: Language: PHP, JavaScript, Python; Frameworks & Frontend: Laravel, Blade, Alpine.js, Vue, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Astro; Backend & Data: Eloquent, Sanctum, Horizon, Scout, Spatie, Redis, MySQL, Oracle, REST API, SOAP; Workflow & Delivery: Git, GitHub Actions, GitHub Pages, GitLab CI, Docker; Security: Threat Modeling, Adversary Emulation, Authentication & Authorization, Rate Limiting, Tenant Isolation, Audit Logging, Upload Inspection; Quality & Reliability: Characterization Testing, Regression Protection, E2E Validation, Observability, Deterministic Outputs; AI & Algorithms: Applied AI, AI-assisted Security Workflows, Algorithm Design, Data Analysis, Optimization
